policy: Per START_HERE_ZH.md and CLEAN_PIPELINE.md, the fixed scale C must come from a physical source (scanner DICOM/manual, simulation definition, or recorded derivation that is independently traceable). Per-image min-max is prohibited as the primary scale. Training-set global min-max is permitted only as an explicitly identified sensitivity arm; the training-set global maximum is a separate sensitivity arm. Neither can be locked as PRIMARY without an external physical source or peer review.
lock_status: PENDING — no scale value can be locked for paper use until either a physical source is recorded or the study is run as sensitivity-only.

brainweb.status: PENDING — BrainWeb PET simulation activity is a digital-phantom quantity with no direct physical Bq/mL constant. The BrainWeb simulator (http://brainweb.bic.mni.mcgill.ca/brainweb/) does not publish a fixed activity concentration in its public documentation. We must either (a) cite the simulation definition that ties each tissue class to a target concentration, (b) contact the BrainWeb authors for a reference value, or (c) accept that no fixed physical scale exists for this dataset and run only sensitivity arms.

training_set_global_max_zero_offset.derivation_rule: max over all train raw_activity arrays (after mean_pool_2x2_circular_fov). Compute via sam-kem calibrate-normalization on train only.
training_set_global_max_zero_offset.evidence_path: PENDING — will be emitted by calibrate-normalization under protocol code/configs/protocols/normalization_calibration.yaml.
training_set_global_max_zero_offset.eligibility: SENSITIVITY ARM ONLY. Not eligible as the primary scale.

training_set_global_minmax.clip_rule: validation values are clipped to [min_train, max_train] only for sensitivity analysis. Zero point is min_train (not 0).
training_set_global_minmax.eligibility: SENSITIVITY ARM ONLY. Not eligible as the primary scale because the zero point is not physical.

hecktor.status: PENDING — HECKTOR.npz::input[...,1] is SUV (max ~4.5-15.2 per the START_HERE_ZH.md guide). The HECKTOR challenge does not publish a single fixed scanner-count constant. The previous v3 attempt used ~30000, but that constant applies to raw scanner counts, not SUV, and MUST NOT be used on the current SUV arrays. The HE dataset also has unresolved physical geometry (see hecktor_geometry.json), so no physical scale can be defended until that is recovered.

physical_scanner_count_constant.evidence_path: PENDING — would require the original scanner list-mode / sinogram data, not present in HECKTOR.npz. This candidate is unavailable for the SUV arrays.
physical_scanner_count_constant.eligibility: NOT APPLICABLE to the current SUV representation.

training_set_global_max_zero_offset.derivation_rule: max over all train raw_activity arrays (after physical_resample_circular_fov). Compute via sam-kem calibrate-normalization on train only.
training_set_global_max_zero_offset.evidence_path: PENDING — will be emitted by calibrate-normalization.
training_set_global_max_zero_offset.eligibility: SENSITIVITY ARM ONLY. Not eligible as the primary scale.

training_set_global_minmax.clip_rule: validation values are clipped to [min_train, max_train] only for sensitivity analysis.

forbidden_uses: Per-dataset arbitrary constant (e.g. 30000) without recorded source.
Test-set-derived constant (must never be opened before freeze).
Training-set global maximum as PRIMARY scale. It is a sensitivity arm only.
Training-set global min-max as PRIMARY scale. It is a sensitivity arm only.
next_step: (1) The researcher must decide whether a physical scale can be sourced for either dataset. If yes, record the source and value here. (2) If no, declare both arms as sensitivity-only and do not produce a primary result on these data. (3) Until either (1) or (2) is decided, `normalization.scale_constants.brainweb` and `.hecktor` in `code/configs/experiment.yaml` remain null, and the audit's FIXED_SCALE_C blocker remains unresolved.
